name: vaultrag-design
description: The DOGFOODING golden set: (query -> expected note) pairs over the live VaultRAG design vault at ../Rag. Unlike corpus_golden.json this set is NOT the CI gate — it drifts on purpose, because its job is to tell us how retrieval feels on the vault we actually use every day (repo CLAUDE.md §1: when retrieval feels bad while building, that is a real bug report). Needs a live Qdrant + Ollama with the project indexed. Grown 20 -> 56 in P2 Stage 1. Run: uv run vaultrag eval --golden design
